name: marekkirejczyk
description: Marek Kirejczyk's skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: marekkirejczyk-skills
plugins.description: explain-with-slides: turns a codebase or a pull request into a walkthrough deck with screenshots from the running code, UML diagrams, key files, code and diff slides, tech stack and lines of code. explain-with-video: turns the same walkthrough into a narrated MP4 with captions, chapters and a transcript. refactor-tests: brings a file, class or branch's tests up to written rules for each test type, and covers every case. self-documented-code: renames everything in a scope so each name explains itself and each concept has one name. dont-repeat-yourself: finds concepts implemented more than once and gives each one well-tested implementation. eval-report: runs a repository's evals and turns the results into one static HTML report for fast review, linked from the pull request. refactor-evals: brings an eval suite's cases up to written rules, with one requirement per case, duplicates merged and every red case diagnosed. baby-sitting: looks after an open pull request until it is merged, keeping it rebased and green and working through the review bot's comments you pick, or merging it once it is green.
